# --ci with a path renders a MiniJinja template with the jobs and the
# repository's details. Undefined variables are errors.
exec git init -q
bit --ci ./ci.tmpl
cmp stdout expected.txt

exec git add .
exec git -c user.email=test@example.com -c user.name=Test commit -qm base
exec git update-ref refs/remotes/origin/trunk HEAD
exec git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD refs/remotes/origin/trunk
mkdir sub
cp BUILD.bit sub/BUILD.bit
cp ci.tmpl sub/ci.tmpl
cd sub
bit --ci ./ci.tmpl image
stdout '\A# rendered by bit --ci \./ci\.tmpl image\nbranch: "trunk"\ndir: "sub"\n'
stdout '^- id=image name="image" large=true command="bit image" selection=\["image"\]$'
! stdout 'id=default'

! bit --ci ../bad.tmpl
stderr 'undefined value: `nope` is undefined \(in \.\./bad\.tmpl:1\)'

! bit --ci ./missing.tmpl
stderr 'cannot read CI template \./missing\.tmpl'

-- BUILD.bit --
lib = exec { command = "true" }

unit = exec.test {
  command = "true"
  depends_on = [lib]
}

large image = exec {
  command = "true"
  depends_on = [lib]
}

publish(name : string) = exec {
  command = "echo #{name}"
  depends_on = [image]
}

group default = [unit, publish(name = "web")]
-- ci.tmpl --
# rendered by {{ command }}
branch: {{ default_branch | tojson }}
dir: {{ working_directory | tojson }}
{% for job in jobs %}
- id={{ job.id }} name={{ job.name | tojson }} large={{ job.large | tojson }} command={{ job.command | tojson }} selection={{ job.selection | tojson }}
{% endfor %}
-- bad.tmpl --
{{ nope }}
-- expected.txt --
# rendered by bit --ci ./ci.tmpl
branch: null
dir: null
- id=default name="default" large=false command="bit unit" selection=["unit"]
- id=image name="image" large=true command="bit publish name=web" selection=["publish","name=web"]
